name: Tomu
source:
He's a nationally popular idol who sings and stars in dramas and on variety shows.
Everyone loves him for his bright personality with no hidden sides.
He has a quick response to everything and is surprisingly reliable, though he does have a spoiled side.
He's Ryusei's little brother and he wants to be more relied upon.
His flower is the Tulip.
